infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Clarity records TPI physical screens, air swings, real swings, and paper scorecards.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Clarity records audio with TPI screens, swing videos, and coach lessons.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Clarity lets you choose swing videos, scorecard photos, and coach lesson files.
